connector.name: Industrial-AIOps Energy
connector.registryDescription: Industrial-AIOps energy edition: IEC-104/DNP3/IEC-61850 read-only OT connectors on iaiops.core.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package iaiops-energy. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the industrial-aiops account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IAIOPS_CONFIG
env.description: Path to the iaiops endpoints config YAML (defines IEC-104/DNP3/IEC-61850 targets); omit to use the default location.

env.name: IAIOPS_MASTER_PASSWORD
env.description: Master password that unlocks the encrypted secret store holding endpoint credentials.

env.name: IAIOPS_NO_EGRESS
env.description: Set to 1 to withhold every data-shipping tool (message bus, external historian, remote LLM) from list_tools() at registration time, for an airgap/sealed-box deployment. A data-exfiltration axis only, not read/write authorisation — every tool is governed and audited. This edition's connectors are monitor-only, so what this withholds are the base brain tools mirrored in from iaiops. Requires iaiops>=0.19.
